quote: It’s possible that records are private, or that cases were referred elsewhere. Whatever the reason,
heading: Born to Be Wild
old: Sometimes we also need to protect people from the rare, but real threat posed by dangerous children. I looked through the research corpus for a well-documented case of a child in an intentional community who remained seriously dangerous to others. I was looking to find the reported conduct, the assessment, the intervention, the review, and what happened later. I couldn’t find one. It’s possible that records are private, or that cases were referred elsewhere. Whatever the reason, I can’t claim communities already know how to handle the hardest cases on their own. In those cases, the child, the family, and the people at risk all need access to competent help and review, hopefully including non-intrusive help from outside the home community.
